en.purpose: To determine the combined TNM assessment and final stage group for hepatocellular carcinoma of the liver.
en.use:
Use to classify hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) of the liver according to the TNM system using categorical Tumour (T), Node (N), and Metastasis (M) inputs.

The guideline expects clinician-assigned TNM categories recorded as coded values:
- T category: TX, T0, T1a, T1b, T2, T3, or T4
- N category: NX, N0, or N1
- M category: M0 or M1

Based on the recorded TNM categories, the guideline determines the corresponding TNM stage group:
- Stage IA: T1a N0 M0
- Stage IB: T1b N0 M0
- Stage II: T2 N0 M0
- Stage IIIA: T3 N0 M0
- Stage IIIB: T4 N0 M0
- Stage IVA: Any T N1 M0

- Stage IVB: Any T Any N M1

The guideline outputs a combined TNM assessment (for example, T1aN0M0) from the selected T, N, and M categories, in addition to the stage group.
en.misuse: Not to be used for staging cholangiocarcinoma or other liver malignancies that have separate TNM classifications.

other_details.references:
Regionala cancercentrum i samverkan. Nationellt vårdprogram levercellscancer: Kapitel 9 Kategorisering av tumören. Kunskapsbanken, 2024. Available at: https://kunskapsbanken.cancercentrum.se/diagnoser/levercellscancer/vardprogram/kategorisering-av-tumoren/

Brierley JD, Gospodarowicz MK, Wittekind C, editors. TNM classification of malignant tumours. 8th ed. Hoboken (NJ): Wiley Blackwell; 2017
other_details.en: A structured guideline used to determine the TNM (Tumour-Node-Metastasis) classification and stage grouping for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) of the liver, based on recorded Tumour (T), Node (N), and Metastasis (M) categories.
